name: Camouflage (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level druid 2, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You touch a creature and its body and clothing shifts in colors and patterns to match their surroundings. The target gains a +10 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks. In areas where the background changes, the colors and patterns change rapidly enough, like moving from rocky mountainside to the snowy peak, the spell reacts rapidly enough to maintain the bonus. If the surroundings change rapidly, like if the target is teleported to a new area or the target moves from a forest to adjacent to a stone building, the target loses the bonus to their Stealth checks for 1 round.
